name: Requires Check
description: A ruleset requires a status-check context to pass before a matching ref can move (`required_status_checks` rule parameters). The properties say from which integration and how strictly; the ruleset's own enforcement stays on the ruleset node rather than being copied here. Derived from the REST ruleset detail, which is administration-gated: a refused detail yields NO edge and is counted as not observable, never as a ruleset with no required checks.

integration_id.description: The GitHub App that must produce the check (15368 is GitHub Actions itself). null means any source may satisfy it — which is a weaker gate, and the reason this is carried explicitly rather than defaulted.

strict.description: `strict_required_status_checks_policy`: the branch must be up to date with the base before merging, so the check ran against what will actually land.

do_not_enforce_on_create.description: The rule is not enforced when the ref is created — a window a fresh branch passes through unchecked.
